Turbo Inlet Pipe, B9/B9.5 Audi S4/S5/SQ5 3.0T

From $129.00

In stock

034-108-5012/
The 034Motorsport Turbo Inlet Pipe for the EA839 3.0T powered Audi S4/S5/SQ5 is an essential upgrade to optimize power by eliminating a critical flow restriction in the intake tract. The 034Motorsport Turbo Inlet Pipe is designed to maximize performance for Dynamic+ Stage 1, 1+, 2, & 2+ Stock Turbo Tuning Software. For upgraded turbochargers, we recommend the SüperDüper Turbo Inlet! This 034Motorsport Turbo Inlet Pipe is not compatible with the SüperDüper S34 Carbon Fiber Intake Systems. Installation Effort: MILD

Summary
    Item Details

    Product Description:

    The EA839 3.0T Turbo Inlet Pipe is designed to work with OEM-sized intake hoses. The CNC machined edge retains the intake hose securely to the turbo inlet pipe. The final touch is an embossed 034 logo to show unsuspecting car show attendees that you value substantive modifications on your 3.0T powered Audi.

    Features:

    • Cast from A356 Aluminum
    • Compressor Inlet Flange Adapter Machined for Smooth Airflow Into Compressor Housing
    • CNC Machined 6061-T6 Aluminum Turbo Inlet Adapter to Match Turbo Inlet for Maximum Airflow - Stock Turbo - 54.0mm
    • Optional Adapter ring available separately: Pure750 Turbo - 63.0mm (034-108-Z094)
    • Increased Flow Over Factory Turbo Inlet
    • CNC Machined Edge Retains Intake Coupler Securely
    • CNC Machined to Retain OE PCV Hose
    • Proven Power/Torque, and Airflow Gains
      • Stock Turbo Inlet: 396 CFM @ 28"H²O
      • 034 Turbo Inlet Pipe w/ Stock Turbo Adapter: 432 CFM @ 28"H²O
      • 034 Turbo Inlet Pipe w/ Pure 750 Turbo Adapter: 490 CFM @ 28"H²O
    • Slotted Lower Turbo Inlet Bolt for Easy Installation
    • Direct Bolt-on Installation.

    OE Part Interchange:

    • 06M 129 665 AL
    • 06M 129 041

    What’s Included:

    • Turbo Inlet Pipe
    • Turbo Adapter Ring, with O-rings - 54mm for OE Turbo
